interview:
I did not win. Here's what happened:

**First game:** I successfully entered my name "ChonkFan" and started playing. I moved the cat up the left column several times, but the guard dog caught up to me and I lost when I moved into a square adjacent to the dog.

**Second game (after "Play again"):** I tried to move the cat but my clicks weren't registering correctly. I kept getting the error message "Le Chonk can only move one square" no matter where I clicked - up, right, or at various positions. The cat stayed stuck at the bottom-left corner (7,1) the entire time, and the move counter stayed at "Moves: 1" from the first game (it seems the counter didn't reset properly, or my clicks weren't being recognized as valid moves).

The core problem was that my pixel coordinate calibration was off - I was clicking at positions that the game wasn't interpreting as the adjacent squares I intended. I never got the cat to actually move in the second game, and the session ended without a win.
